Summary: enterprise financial platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for low-latency customer-facing chat + internal reranking and embeddings search. Heavy compliance needs (KMS/HSM, audit logs, residency). Goal: replace partial in-house GPU fleet for customer chat and risk pipelines; move to reserved capacity with clear throughput guarantees and latency SLOs.

Key requirements (from RFP + call):
- Workloads: chat assistant (customer support, 2 concurrent conversations per user), reranking for transaction-search, embeddings for KYC/document search, nightly batch summarization jobs.
- Baseline steady-state: 120 QPS (requests/sec) of short-chat prompts (avg 80 tokens input, 120 tokens output) => ~24k tokens/sec steady-state.
- Peak bursts: 600 QPS for 3-5 minutes during market opens (spike traffic) => ~120k tokens/sec peak.
- P95 latency target: <= 150ms per-token (interactive); end-to-end p95 for chat responses <= 400ms for short responses. P99 target for API: <= 900ms.
- Throughput guarantees wanted: sustained tokens/sec floor + burst crediting model (30s bursts without throttling).
- Desired reserved GPU plan: initial footprint targeting equivalent of 8x H100-class GPUs (or quantized A100 cluster) with autoscale-to-12 during peak; prefer predictable slot-based reservation over purely cloud burst.
- KV cache / session affinity: session hot-cache for chat histories required (per-user affinity across up to 7 tokens/sec/session).
- Cost sensitivity: price per token must beat in-house marginal cost by >=20% to justify migration.
